rationale: Only exact GENERATIVEQC_HF_COLD_SCREENING=1 selects the bounded cold FP64 proposal and larger reusable pages. Unset/0/none/empty/invalid values preserve the incumbent ordinary operator and 8M-task/1.5-GiB/one-sixteenth-memory page policy. The frozen pre-containment source improved HF96 timing but increased default force error from 5.10e-8 to 3.02e-7 Eh/Bohr, failing the unchanged additional 1e-7 diagnostic. Tighter requests qualified the optional route, not the failed default; all measured failures and historical source identities remain retained. The speedup is not claimed for restored defaults.
revisit_condition: Before any default promotion, resolve the retained default-request force failure and requalify the bounded affected cold/warm case against its independent reference without changing thresholds. Preserve complete FP64 work, iteration allowances, physical-reference admission and page-refusal behavior. Historical tight-target results are not default qualification.
